title: Endangered Species
description: Stranded in a wilderness park in Kenya, a man, his family and a friend find themselves in a desperate fight for survival when they encounter a vicious leopard and a pack of hyenas.

title: Rumble Through the Dark
description: A desperate, bare-knuckle cage fighter battles to save his family home against the strongest of foes and the longest of odds.

title: Seized
description: A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

title: Survive the Night
description: A trauma doctor is forced to operate on a wounded gunman as he and his family are held hostage by the man and his unhinged brother.

title: The Cold Light of Day
description: A vacation in Spain turns nightmarish when a man's (Henry Cavill) family is kidnapped by agents who are hell-bent on recovering a mysterious briefcase.

title: The Next Three Days
description: A man fails in his attempts to establish his wife's innocence of murder, and she has no appeals left, so he (Russell Crowe) hatches an elaborate plan to break her out of prison.
